### Model Statistic & CV App

The goal of this app is to give coaches an objective way to measure meaningful change beyond normal variation or noise. Using the model statistic (loosely considered a single-subject dependent t-test) & CV method first outlined by Harry, et al. in 2024 and coined by Oregon biomechanist Barry Bates in 1992.
